Congress and NCP-SP Merger Talks Reported to Be in Final Stages

Reports indicate that discussions are ongoing for a potential merger between the Congress party and a faction of Sharad Pawar's Nationalist Congress Party (NCP-SP). Sources suggest these talks are in the final stages, with a section of the NCP-SP faction favoring the merger. The situation is also described as a crossroads for the NCP-SP, with an internal rift widening.
